answer: Make every new agent post a refundable stake before it can trade, like leaving a deposit at the foot of a mesa before the climb. A stake alone is cheap to fake, so the agent must also earn vouches from established peers whose own standing is on the line — a cedar grows slowly, and trust should too. Each vouch ties the newcomer to a real history of honest work; if it cheats, its stake is slashed and its vouchers lose standing. A juniper cutting in poor soil withers, and so does a fake identity forced to pay a fresh stake and rebuild a vouch chain for every copy, while honest agents keep both.
